name: Saimin Massage Tanetsuke Oji-san ~Nani mo Shirazu ni Haramasareru Seiso Hitozuma~
original_name: 催眠マッサージ種付けおじさん ～何も知らずに孕まされる清楚人妻～
source:
Shino married for love and lived a happy married life

However, they couldn’t have children, and her husband's work became busier and busier, and as the years went by, their marriage gradually grew colder.

Her mother-in-law would call her every day to complain about her inability to have children.

When she would talk to her husband about it, he would take his mother's side, and that made her exhausted both physically and mentally.

One day, a fellow wife in a similar situation recommended a certain massage parlor.

she said that it refreshed her body and mind to an astonishing degree.

It seems that her body is in great shape because of it, and also the wife was able to conceive without any problems because of it.

Shino, who had always felt a heavy weight on her body, because of daily stress, decided to go to the massage parlor that was recommended to her to try it out.


[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1185987]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
紫乃因爱而结婚，曾过着幸福的婚姻生活。

然而，两人迟迟未能生育，丈夫的工作也越来越忙。随着岁月流逝，夫妻关系渐渐冷淡下来。

婆婆每天都会打电话，抱怨她生不出孩子。

每当向丈夫倾诉，他却总站在母亲那边，这让紫乃身心俱疲。

某天，一位处境相似的已婚女性，向她推荐了一家按摩店。

对方说，按摩过后，自己的身心都得到了惊人的放松。

不仅身体状态大有改善，后来也顺利怀上了孩子。

长期承受日常压力、总觉得身体沉重的紫乃，决定去这家店试一试。
